title: CollapseReceipt
description: JM's collapse act: freezes one garden block and its ancestry chain, copies to temple/proposals/. authority=false — the actual ledger entry requires JM running helen_say manually. Collapse selects; it never deletes.

block_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the collapsed artifact's content.

block_id.description: The artifact ID (SEED-*, INS-*, CLM-*) that was collapsed.

block_type.description: Which Lego block tier was collapsed.

ancestry_chain.description: Full chain of parent artifact hashes from this block back to its DreamSeed roots.

collapsed_by.description: Who performed the collapse. Should be 'JM' — only the operator collapses.

destination.description: Where the frozen block was copied. Always temple/proposals/ for Z3 staging.

siblings_preserved.description: IDs of sibling artifacts at the same block type that remain uncollapsed in Z2.

authority.description: Always false. Collapse is non-sovereign. The ledger entry requires helen_say (JM's act).

ledger_effect.description: Always none. Collapse does not write to the ledger directly.

actor.description: Always COLLAPSE_CLI. The tool performs the freeze; JM performs the collapse.

note.description: Human-readable note about what was collapsed and why.
